responsibility: Declares the common channel-opening flag sets and open-result enumerations shared across the ISO gm2 I/O subsystem. It standardizes the request/availability flags for read, write, text, raw, interactive, and related channel properties, and the OpenResults codes that device modules such as file, socket, memory, and argument channels return when opening or validating channels.
same_name_distinction: This Modula-2 definition module is the canonical language-level declaration of channel flag sets and open-result enums; unlike ChanConsts.h it includes the full Modula-2 FlagSet/ChanFlags API, and unlike the empty ChanConsts.mod it is where the actual shared interface is defined.
